text.aria-label: Title text 'Planned contrasts in quantile score (C2 in pinball loss at the 0.99 quantile), mean over six farms, 12 to 36 h, 2025-09 to 2026-08. Dot: estimate. Line: 99% interval from resampling whole months (Bonferroni over four contrasts). M1 is a post hoc check. Grey rule: no change.'
text.tspan: Planned contrasts in quantile score (C2 in pinball loss at the 0.99 quantile), mean over six farms,
12 to 36 h, 2025-09 to 2026-08. Dot: estimate. Line: 99% interval from resampling whole months
(Bonferroni over four contrasts). M1 is a post hoc check. Grey rule: no change.
